description: Minimum required capabilities for Natives — each permission is scoped to the minimum needed. Keep this file reviewed.
note: Capability isolation (CR-403): 'webview: ["main"]' means only the main Renderer webview gets these permissions. Child WebViews created via browser.rs with labels like 'creative-app-{appId}' do NOT match the 'main' filter, so they inherit zero Tauri capabilities. This prevents any Embed surface from invoking Tauri IPC commands like shell:allow-open, fs:*, or window:*. The on_navigation hook on each child WebView further restricts navigation to loopback addresses only.
